title:
Your Shopee orders,
ready for a spreadsheet.
body: A simple guide to exporting your purchase history.
narration: All those Shopee orders? Let’s turn them into a spreadsheet! Here’s how to get started with Trako Order Exporter.

title:
Start with your
purchase history.
body: Install Trako, sign in to Shopee normally, and open My Purchases.
narration: First up: install Trako in Chrome, sign in to Shopee, and open My Purchases. Look for the little Trako panel. That’s where you’ll start!

title:
Load the orders
you want included.
body: Scroll down. Use Load More if available. Only loaded orders are scanned.
narration: Want more orders in your export? Scroll down to load them first. Tap Load More if it appears. Remember: Trako scans what’s already loaded on this page.

title:
One button
starts the scan.
body: Select Export orders to CSV in the on-page Trako panel.
narration: Ready? Click Export orders to CSV! Trako checks your loaded orders for completed purchases. Orders with other statuses are skipped.

title:
See the progress
and estimated time.
body: Keep this page open. Select Cancel export to stop the scan.
narration: Watch the progress right here, along with the estimated time left. You might see temporary order tabs while Trako checks details. Need to stop? Hit Cancel export.

title:
Understand what
was skipped.
body: Read the product name and reason. Select Scan again when you need a fresh scan.
narration: Something got skipped? Check the product name and the reason underneath. An order still marked To Receive won’t be included. Want a fresh scan? Click Scan again. Load more orders first to include more!
callout: Review the reason. Scan again if needed.

title:
Choose where
to save your file.
body: Confirm the filename, choose a folder, then select Save.
narration: When your file is ready, choose a folder, give it a name, and click Save. Nice and simple!

title:
Your export
is ready to review.
body: Open the CSV in Excel, Google Sheets, or WPS. Widen columns to read long values.
narration: Now open the CSV in your spreadsheet app. Each product has its own row. Seeing hash marks? Widen the column! Some fields may stay blank if the details aren’t available.
callout: One product per row • Available details

title:
Load. Scan.
Save your CSV.
body: Your order data is processed in your browser and is not sent to Trako servers.
narration: And you’re done! Load your orders, scan with Trako, and save your CSV. Your order data stays in your browser and isn’t sent to Trako servers. Happy organizing!
